task_instance: Analyse BTC on the 1h, 4h and 1d timeframes with the default trend/momentum indicators plus key levels, funding and open interest, and present the single-coin read in the skill's prescribed order (price line, per-timeframe lines, confluence, levels table, derivatives line, what-would-change-the-read, risk disclaimer).
blocker_detail: The skill's entire deliverable is built from live data returned by the hosted TraderSpy MCP server tools (get_technical_indicators, get_derivatives, get_price, get_candles, get_tracked_symbols). The skill itself states this server must be connected in the client over Streamable HTTP and authorized with OAuth or a personal key tied to a TraderSpy account; without the server the skill explicitly 'has no data to work from.' This office-assistant runtime grants only text file read/write/edit and web fetch/search; it has no connection to that MCP server, and the server requires an authorized account/key that is not available. The run's safety rules also forbid calling any MCP/connector tool and (this round) forbid web fetch/search. There is no bundled script or offline dataset to substitute, and fabricating indicator/funding/OI values the server would return is disallowed, so the core technical-analysis read cannot be genuinely produced or verified.
evidence: Read the skill document SKILL.md at the skill plugin path. It defines a crypto-futures technical-analysis read whose numbers come exclusively from TraderSpy MCP tools (table of get_technical_indicators / get_derivatives / get_price / get_candles / get_tracked_symbols). The Limitations section states the hosted TraderSpy MCP server must be connected in the client over Streamable HTTP and authorized with OAuth or a personal key from a TraderSpy account, and that without the server the skill has no data. No such MCP server is connected or permitted in this runtime, and no bundled offline data generator exists; the only genuine way to produce the deliverable (real indicator/level/funding/OI values for a chosen symbol) is a call to that account-authorized server, which is unavailable. No deliverable file could therefore be produced; only this result.json was written to the work directory.
